dataset_name: IELTS Golden Dataset for RAG Evaluation
description: High-quality IELTS speaking and writing test sets for RAG system evaluation. Each speaking set requires all 3 parts, each writing set requires both tasks to calculate band score.

questions: What is your daily routine?
Do you prefer weekdays or weekends?
How do you usually spend your evenings?

part_2.cue_card:
Describe your favourite day of the week.

You should say:
- which day it is
- what you usually do on that day
- why it is your favourite

and explain what makes this day special.

questions: Do you think work-life balance is important?
How can people achieve a better work-life balance?
Has work-life balance changed in recent years?

task_1.question: The bar chart shows the number of students enrolled in different university subjects in 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

task_2.question: Some people believe that children should start school at a very young age. Others think they should not start school until they are older. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

writing_sets.scoring_requirement: Both Task 1 and Task 2 must be completed to calculate overall band score

task_1.question: The line graph shows the average temperature in four major cities from 1990 to 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

task_2.question: In many countries, people are living longer than ever before. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this trend?

writing_sets.scoring_requirement: Both Task 1 and Task 2 must be completed to calculate overall band score

metadata.purpose: Evaluation of RAG system responses for IELTS preparation content
metadata.source: IELTS official samples and examiner-graded responses
metadata.note: Each speaking set requires all 3 parts answered. Each writing set requires both Task 1 and Task 2 answered to calculate overall band score. Full test (Speaking + Writing) requires 4 tasks to calculate overall band.
